annotations.title: Who qualifies, and how it is reported

description: Explains who can claim the 2025-2028 One Big Beautiful Bill Act deductions for overtime, tips and seniors: years covered, excluded filing status (married filing separately), the valid-SSN rule, FLSA overtime eligibility, and exactly where the amounts are reported (Form W-2 box 12 codes TT and TP, Form 1099-NEC/1099-MISC/1099-K boxes, Schedule 1-A lines), including the 2026 change that only W-2 box 12 code TT amounts count. Taken from IRS FAQs and forms fetched Oct 2026.

tax_year.description: Tax year, 2025 to 2028. The deductions end after 2028.

topic.description: overtime, tips, senior or all (default all).
